2645-3756-5963-6871-7115.description:
Cast Staff of Domination by paying {3}.
Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Izzet Boilerworks.
Cast Marvin by paying {2}.
Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Staff of Domination.
At the beginning of your end step, Toph, the First Metalbender triggers, earthbending Marvin, thus giving it haste.
Activate Marvin using Izzet Boilerworks's ability by tapping it, adding {U}{R}
Activate Marvin using Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping Marvin.
Repeat from step 6.

3734-3899-4375.description:
Cast Technomancer by paying {5}{B}{B}.
When Technomancer enters, it triggers, causing you to mill three cards and return Phyrexian Metamorph from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Technomancer.
When Phyrexian Metamorph enters, it triggers. Holding priority, activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Phyrexian Metamorph.
Resolve the Phyrexian Metamorph trigger, causing you to mill three cards and return Phyrexian Metamorph from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Technomancer.
Repeat from step 3.

3536-5078-6666.description:
Declare Cheering Fanatic as an attacker. When it triggers, choose to name "Sensei's Divining Top".
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} due to Cheering Fanatic.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Rook Turret triggers.
Holding priority, activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Resolve the Rook Turret trigger, causing you to draw Sensei's Divining Top from your library, and then discard a card other than Sensei's Divining Top.
Repeat from step 2

4985-5078-7902.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} due to Jhoira's Familiar.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Fateful Discovery triggers.
Holding priority, activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Resolve the Fateful Discovery trigger, causing you to draw Sensei's Divining Top from your library
Repeat

2021-2060-6627-7704.description:
Activate Simic Ascendancy by paying {1}{G}{U}, putting four +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Simic Ascendancy triggers, putting growth counters on it.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's second ability by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{G}{U}.
Repeat.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Simic Ascendancy triggers, causing you to win the game.

1563-1753-2457-7824.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two tokens.
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

129-647-1409-6723.description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by tapping it, adding {U}.
Kinnan triggers, adding {U}.
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, its soulbond ability triggers, repairing it with another creature.
Repeat.

4644-5983-7791.description:
Activate Snapping Voidcraw by tapping it, adding {C}{C}
Activate Tidewater Minion by tapping it, targeting Snapping Voidcraw.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Tidewater Minion's ability, targeting Tidewater Minion.
Resolve both Tidewater Minion abilities, untapping it and Snapping Voidcraw.
Repeat.

245-1069-5499-7297.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.
245-1069-5499-7297.description:
Activate Marneus Calgar by paying {6}, creating two 2/2 Astartes Warrior creature tokens.
When the Astartes Warriors enter the battlefield, Marneus Calgar triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, attaching it to an Astartes Warrior.
Activate the Astartes Warrior with Lotus Ring attached by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {3}.
Repeat from step 3 for the remaining Astartes Warrior.
Repeat from step 1.

2366-5414-5929-6879.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
2366-5414-5929-6879.description:
Play Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Arbor enters as an Ally due to Leyline of Transformation, Haru triggers, earthbending Dryad Arbor.
Activate Dryad Arbor by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Troubled Healer by sacrificing Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Abor dies, Haru triggers, returning Dryad Arbor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Dryad Arbor enters as an Ally due to Leyline of Transformation, Haru triggers, earthbending Dryad Arbor.
Resolve the Troubled Healer ability.
Repeat from step 3.

147-3495-5231.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
147-3495-5231.description:
Cast Breach the Multiverse by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Breach the Multiverse.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Breach the Multiverse, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage
Resolve the Breach the Multiverse copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
147-3495-5231.notes: Breach the Multiverse can put all creature cards from all graveyards and libraries onto the battlefield under your control infinitely. It will also infinitely mill all players.

1062-1272-3487-5674.notablePrerequisites: You have at least 3 land cards in your hand.
1062-1272-3487-5674.description:
Activate Seismic Assault by discarding a land card.
Slogurk triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Seismic Assault ability.
Repeat from step 1 two additional times.
Activate Slogurk by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
When Slogurk leaves the battlefield, it triggers, returning three land cards from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Slogurk by paying {E} due to Primal Prayers.
When Slogurk enters, Aetherstorm Roc triggers, causing you to get {E}.
Repeat.

2438-5617-6553.easyPrerequisites: Fungal Fortitude attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
2438-5617-6553.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Brotherhood Outcast.
When Brotherhood Outcast dies, Fungal Fortitude triggers, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Brotherhood Outcast enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Fungal Fortitude from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

783-1399-1606-4875.description:
Activate Jungle Basin by tapping it, adding {C}{G}.
Activate Ley Weaver by tapping it, untapping Wirewood Lodge and Jungle Basin.
Activate Wirewood Lodge's second ability by paying {G} and tapping it, untapping Ley Weaver.
Repeat.

190-389-3629-3778.easyPrerequisites: Cloudsteel Kirin attached to a creature you control.
190-389-3629-3778.description:
Cast Fractured Identity by paying {3}{W}{U}, exiling Nine Lives and causing each opponent to create a token copy of it.
Nine Lives leaves the battlefield, however you cannot lose the game due to Cloudsteel Kirin.
Cast Austere Command by paying its mana cost, destroying all enchantments.
When each opponent's Nine Lives leaves the battlefield, they each trigger, causing each opponent to lose the game.

11-2575-5257.description:
Cast Temporal Mastery by paying {5}{U}{U}.
Riku's first ability triggers - choose not to pay.
Holding priority, cast Narset's Reversal by paying {U}{U}, targeting Temporal Mastery.
Riku's first ability triggers, causing you to pay {U}{R} to copy Narset's Reversal, with the copy targeting the original Narset's Reversal.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, copying the original Narset's Reversal targeting Temporal Mastery, and returning the original Narset's Reversal to your hand.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal created in step 5, copying Temporal Mastery and returning the original Temporal Mastery to your hand.
Resolve Temporal Mastery, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.
11-2575-5257.notes: You may pay an additional {U}{R} to copy the extra turn spell, and only need to do this loop during your second extra turn.

128-1339-2837.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to draw a card.
There is at least one Insect on the battlefield.
128-1339-2837.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 3/1 Dog creature token due to Jinnie Fay.
When the Dog enters the battlefield, Elemental Bond triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.
128-1339-2837.notes: This combo will result in you drawing your library, and losing the game if it isn't interacted with. Ensure you have a way to avoid this before starting the combo.

4415-5674-5870.notablePrerequisites: You have at least {E} or enough mana to cast Stonecloaker
4415-5674-5870.description:
Cast Stonecloaker by paying {E} due to Primal Prayers, if able, or by paying its mana cost.
When Stonecloaker enters the battlefield, it and Guide of Souls trigger.
Resolve the Guide of Souls trigger, causing you to get {E} and gain 1 life.
Resolve the Stonecloaker trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1641-2034-2054-4452.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Promised Kannushi, adding {C}{C}.
When Promised Kannushi dies, its soulshift ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Urn of Godfire's first ability by paying {2}, adding {G}.
Cast Promised Kannushi by paying {G}.
Repeat.

1722-2034-2089.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
1722-2034-2089.description:
Draw a card.
Nadir Kraken triggers, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on it, and to create a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
The Tentacle enters the battlefield, triggering Symmetry Matrix.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Tentacle, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Symmetry Matrix trigger, causing you to pay {1} to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

1887-3899-4871.notablePrerequisites: Spawning Pit has at least two charge counters.
1887-3899-4871.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating a 2/2 Spawn artifact creature token.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability by sacrificing the Spawn.
The Spawn dies, triggering Pitiless Plunderer, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability, putting two charge counters on it.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

710-3055-4050.notablePrerequisites: Gift of Immortality attached to Danitha.
710-3055-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Danitha, adding one mana of any color.
When Danitha dies, Gift of Immortality triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Gift of Immortality from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Repeat.
